heading: Import file set
introduction: Keep related original files in one private collection. Files are never executed, converted or unpacked.
title: Collection title
folderHelp: Folder selection keeps the selected folder name and every file's relative path. Empty folders are not included. Choose a purpose for this intake; use separate intakes when sources have different purposes.
selectionHelp: Files are registered and uploaded in batches. Each acquisition keeps its own identity, even when file contents match. You can pause and continue an unfinished set.
resumeHelp: Pause or close this view to continue later. Received originals are kept. The complete set is attached after verification.
identityHelp: Each original keeps its own acquisition identity.
completeFiles: Select the complete original file set again
jobStopping: Stopping file set processing. Received originals are retained.
jobCancelled: File set processing cancelled. Received originals are retained.
jobFailed: File set processing failed. Retry verification when ready.
jobRelocated: This file set moved. Reopen it to continue.
refreshFailed: Status could not be refreshed. Reopen this file set to check. {error}
completeSet: Select the complete original set to finish its saved manifest.
differentManifest: This selection differs from the saved original set. No saved originals were replaced.
differentFiles: Some selected files differ from the saved file set. Select the original files; received originals were kept.
paused: Paused. Received files and chunks are retained.
interrupted: Upload interrupted. Reopen the file set to resume.
confirmFailed: Could not confirm the saved set. Retry with the same files.
receivedHelp: Selected files received. Choose Verify and attach file set when all files are ready.
actionFailed: Could not confirm this action. Reopen the file set to check or retry. {error}
selectionUnavailable: The selected file list could not be read. Select the files again.
